name: Motion for a resolution
title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the need for the EU’s continuous support for Ukraine
part_text:
This text is a motion for a resolution from a political group in the European Parliament. It does not change any law. It sets out the group's position: it condemns Russia's attack on Ukraine and the strike on a children's hospital in Kyiv, calls for an immediate end to the fighting and for diplomacy, and backs Ukraine's independence and territory. It also says each member state decides for itself on financial, military and diplomatic support, and that Ukraine must meet all conditions, including protecting national minorities, before joining the EU.

- Nothing changes in law; Parliament is only asked to state a position.
- It affects EU governments and Ukraine, which is urged to protect minorities and fight corruption.
- Next, Parliament would debate and vote on whether to adopt the text.
